articles.title: 三星投144万亿韩元扩产
articles.summary: 三星宣布在韩国忠清地区投资约7200亿元人民币，扩建半导体封装、OLED面板、AI服务器基板和电池产线。
articles.why: 这是AI硬件供应链的大动作，说明大厂在押注AI服务器和芯片封装需求会持续增长，未来AI设备可能更多也更快。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注：AI不只在软件里，背后需要大量芯片和工厂。
articles.source_title: 三星启动 144 万亿韩元大投资，扩建半导体、显示器、基板和电池的生产设施

articles.title: 华为鸿蒙装机量破1亿
articles.summary: 华为鸿蒙HarmonyOS 5及以上版本装机量突破1亿台，开发者超1100万，应用与服务超38万。
articles.why: 这是国产操作系统的一个里程碑，意味着更多App会适配鸿蒙，普通用户未来换手机时多了一个生态选择。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想：操作系统和AI应用之间是什么关系？
articles.source_title: 里程碑时刻！曝华为鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 装机量突破 1 亿台

articles.title: 苹果研究AI健康工具效果
articles.summary: 苹果宣布与临床AI平台OpenEvidence合作开展研究，了解人们如何使用对话式AI健康工具，以及这些回答到底有多大帮助。
articles.why: 大厂开始认真评估AI健康问答的实际效果，而不是只宣传功能，这对以后普通人用AI问健康问题是否靠谱很关键。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 值得观察：AI给的医疗建议，怎么判断靠不靠谱？
articles.source_title: Apple’s new study looks to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools

articles.title: 印度芯片公司获2400万美元
articles.summary: 印度芯片初创公司Bharat Semi获得2400万美元种子轮融资，其AI传感器技术已拿到包括General Atomics在内的客户设计订单。
articles.why: AI芯片创业不只在美中，印度也在切入AI传感器市场，说明AI硬件竞争正在扩散到更多国家。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以留意：AI传感器是做什么用的？
articles.source_title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market

articles.title: 微软365全球宕机后恢复
articles.summary: Microsoft 365服务在持续约19小时到30多小时的全球宕机后恢复，影响大量办公用户。
articles.why: 很多人日常工作依赖微软办公服务，这次长时间故障提醒我们：再大的云服务也会出问题，重要资料最好有本地备份。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 想一想：你常用的在线工具如果突然打不开，有备用方案吗？
articles.source_title: 派早报：Microsoft 365 服务在 19 小时全球宕机后恢复

articles.title: 斯坦福等发布湿实验预测基准
articles.summary: 斯坦福、哈佛、康奈尔等十余家团队联合发布被称为“史上最严”的湿实验预测基准，测试发现即使推理拉满、算力翻5倍，AI表现仍不理想。
articles.why: 这说明AI在真实科学实验预测上还有明显短板，对想用AI辅助科研的人来说，是个提醒：AI不是万能的，实验验证仍不可少。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以关注：AI在哪些科研任务上还靠不住？
articles.source_title: 「史上最严」湿实验预测基准发布！推理拉满、算力翻5倍也白搭

articles.title: 硅谷预测中期选举翻车
articles.summary: MIT科技评论发文质疑硅谷大佬自称能预见未来，却在中期选举预测上集体失准。
articles.why: 这提醒普通用户：科技领袖的“远见”不等于准确判断，听他们谈AI未来时也要保持独立思考。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想：为什么科技大佬的预测也会错？
articles.source_title: Silicon Valley claims to know the future. So why did it get the midterms so wrong?

articles.title: 脑植入试验志愿者提新要求
articles.summary: 参与脑植入设备试验的志愿者提出更多自主权和更少保密协议的要求，希望被更好地认可。
articles.why: 脑机接口是AI相关前沿方向，志愿者权益问题会影响这类研究怎么推进，也关系到未来技术伦理。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以关注：新技术试验中，参与者该有哪些权利？
articles.source_title: More autonomy, fewer NDAs: Volunteers have new requests for brain implant trials

articles.title: 三星SDI签16GWh储能电池合同
articles.summary: 三星SDI宣布将在2029至2031年向美国Jupiter Power供应16GWh磷酸铁锂储能电池，交易价值数万亿韩元。
articles.why: AI数据中心耗电大，储能电池需求跟着涨，这条新闻说明AI的电力配套正在成为大生意。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 可以想：AI和电有什么关系？
articles.source_title: 三星 SDI 签署数万亿韩元合同，向 Jupiter Power 供应 16GWh LFP 储能电池

items.title_en: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
items.summary: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 doma
items.title_cn: SO-Arena：评测System One模型的能力谱系与决策可靠性
items.note: 提出覆盖11个领域的基准，考察快速决策模型的能力广度与可靠性。

items.title_en: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
items.summary: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and vehicles can be occluded. items.title_cn: BirdDreams：面向可信反应式驾驶世界模型的联合视角与BEV视频生成
items.note: 联合生成视角视频与BEV，让驾驶世界模型可控且运动合理。

items.title_en: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
items.summary: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to s
items.title_cn: PhysLoop：利用大模型物理认知自我改进视频生成模型
items.note: 用LLM判断物理合理性，构造纠正数据迭代提升视频生成。

items.title_en: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
items.summary: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity. Based on product quantization, we show that, under a fixed nominal information budget, group size should scale quadratically with the per-axis spatial compression factor. Building on this principle, we propose GSTAR, a spatial--grou
items.title_cn: G-STAR：面向深度压缩自回归生成的组规模令牌容量
items.note: 基于乘积量化推导组大小与压缩倍数的平方关系，兼顾质量与速度。

items.title_en: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.summary: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fu
items.title_cn: Duo：面向全双工交互的互惠世界模型
items.note: 提出互惠世界模型，实时感知视听输入并同步回应用户。

items.title_en: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
items.summary: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, depen
items.title_cn: 从结构化教科书中扩展数学证明监督
items.note: 将2118本数学教材转为38万条保留章节与依赖结构的证明数据。

items.title_en: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
items.summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce
items.title_cn: SteerDistill：通过闭环教师引导量化LLM智能体
items.note: 用闭环教师纠正量化智能体的行为偏差，降低低比特量化损失。

items.title_en: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formu
items.title_cn: 通过强化学习激励大语言模型自我学习
items.note: 研究模型自主检索、研读并应用长文档知识解题的自我学习能力。

items.title_en: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
items.summary: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model. Its Read Intent Protocol tracks evolving needs and source coverage; Adaptive Reader Backends select how eviden
items.title_cn: 少读多解：AI智能体的令牌高效稀疏阅读
items.note: 加一层阅读控制，只让智能体读取所需证据，省令牌降延迟。

items.title_en: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific pred
items.title_cn: 面向提示自适应与成本感知LLM推理的集成路由
items.note: 按提示自适应选择单模型或模型集成，兼顾质量与推理成本。

items.title_en: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
items.summary: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation u
items.title_cn: 基于条件偏移的少步流式视频生成
items.note: 用条件偏移在生成器内估计速度场，免去额外假评分网络。

items.title_en: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
items.summary: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. This is because lessons are inferred from trajectories labeled only with task success or failure, yet are typically provided without the trajectori
items.title_cn: 别只信记忆：证据关联记忆减少LLM智能体的记忆致退化
items.note: 给记忆教训附上来源轨迹证据，减少误用错误经验导致的退化。

items.title_en: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.summary: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world tran
items.title_cn: 面向智能体机器人操作的世界上下文学习
items.note: 利用上下文学习迁移语义任务步骤，让机器人跨场景复用经验。

items.title_en: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
items.summary: Weight-space programming, introduced in recent MIT work by Takehi et al., enables a frontier LLM agent to read a network's weights and write a repair. Their GPT-6 Astra agent corrected the reasoning loops of Qwen3.5-0.8B without gradients, using 158 agent turns, 89.7 million tokens, and 50 forward-pass requests. Our method, Tree-Ising, casts this repair as a sparse discrete optimization problem over the model's own BF16 weights. Forward statistics define an objective that weakens a loop directio
items.title_cn: Tree-Ising：用比特级Ising编辑修复语言模型
items.note: 把权重修复转为BF16权重上的稀疏离散优化，削弱推理循环。

items.title_en: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
items.summary: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well. We introduce the One Table Benchmark (), spanning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 capability axes under aligned data splits and explicit task contracts. We compare task ranks on aligned support, train five backbon
items.title_cn: 一表多查：跨生成、插补与预测的通用表格模型基准
items.note: 建56数据集基准，统一评测生成、插补、预测三类表格能力。

items.title_en: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous ta
items.title_cn: 面向通用灵巧操作的异构触觉表征学习
items.note: 学习摆脱传感器物理差异的触觉表征，统一利用多种触觉传感器。

items.title_en: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.summary: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disci
items.title_cn: Sage-Taiyi：面向科学发现的元认知架构
items.note: 用元认知监控与调控指导研究方向选择与推理方法复用。

items.title_en: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
items.summary: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to
items.title_cn: WorldFoundry：面向世界智能的统一基础设施
items.note: 定义生成式世界模型为持久状态预测系统，并搭建统一基础设施。

items.title_en: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
items.summary: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets
items.title_cn: Infrathon：评测语言智能体做真实长周期AI基础设施优化
items.note: 设150个24小时长周期基建优化任务，考察智能体持续改进能力。

items.title_en: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. items.title_cn: Reframe：面向智能体视觉推理的观测对齐多教师在线蒸馏
items.note: 把观测状态而非仅输出分布作为对齐对象，改善工具使用推理。

items.title_en: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
items.summary: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. items.title_cn: Confucius4-R2T2：面向真实实时转写的稳定前缀流式ASR
items.note: 流式识别永不修改已输出token，兼顾准确率与低延迟。

items.title_en: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
items.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P^2-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. items.title_cn: P^2-MOPD：用参数先验加速多教师在线蒸馏
items.note: 把学生与专家参数线性组合当可微模型，联合优化混合系数与权重。

items.title_en: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
items.summary: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything
items.title_cn: SplatAnything：面向任意场景前馈3DGS的高斯间距归一化
items.note: 归一化高斯中心间距，缓解跨场景尺度导致的监督歧义。

items.title_en: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
items.summary: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. items.title_cn: 迈向智能体具身智能时代
items.note: 以代码为扩展接口的多智能体框架，兼顾高效控制与失败恢复。

items.title_en: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
items.summary: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric
items.title_cn: PCBRouteAgent：LLM智能体离PCB布线工程师还有多远
items.note: 多模态智能体结合全局规划与局部执行，完成复杂电路板布线。

items.title_en: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
items.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. items.title_cn: VFlash：基于Flash图元解码的快速准确视觉规划
items.note: 利用图元结构一次解码多点坐标，加速机器人视觉规划。

items.title_en: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
items.summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. Large foundation models now write code and run multistep tasks, and personal agents act on a person's behalf. Yet people still forget what they once knew, miss what they are not looking at, fail to find the right words, and face hard choices without the benefit of their own history, because the machine that could help stands outside the situation. items.title_cn: 从自主智能体到认知共生体：走向AI增强的人类智能
items.note: 主张AI应从替代人转向嵌入情境、增强人的认知与决策。

items.title_en: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
items.summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. However, vision-language-action (VLA) foundations largely inherit visual representations from 2D vision-language pre-training, while spatial supervision is often introduced only during task-specific adaptation. items.title_cn: SLA：通过持续预训练扩展空间-语言-动作模型
items.note: 用大规模机器人经验持续预训练，把空间理解变成可迁移能力。

items.title_en: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
items.summary: Harness evolution from a common base exhibits Locality, Complementarity, and Nonstationarity: variants repair different failures, and their utility changes as the policy learns. Rather than seeking a universally superior harness, we introduce Harness-S to selectively rescue failures of a base execution system through sibling harnesses and transfer the resulting capabilities into a single policy that remains effective under the original harness. items.title_cn: Harness-S：从兄弟执行框架学习可泛化智能体训练
items.note: 用多个同源执行框架互补修复失败，把能力蒸馏进单一策略。

items.title_en: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
items.summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. To quantify estimation error, we derive an accurate analytical approximation to the error distribution when estimating full-benchmark scores from a subset, showing that most subsets yield small errors, while a few produce much larger errors, resulting in a long-tailed distribution. items.title_cn: 随机几乎够用？用BestRand实现稳定低成本基准压缩
items.note: 分析子集误差长尾分布，提出更稳定的基准子集挑选方法。

items.title_en: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
items.summary: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review
items.title_cn: FrontierPhysics：评测智能体做端到端物理研究
items.note: 42位物理学家出56个真实研究任务，同时考察正确性与研究质量。

items.title_en: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. items.title_cn: 从像素到动作：走向原生视觉-语言-动作策略
items.note: 让动作策略直接访问演化中的视觉计算，而非固定编码器输出。

items.title_en: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
items.summary: A frontier AI model is trained in an AI data center, on tens of thousands of accelerators joined by a dedicated network, and every training step ends with all of them exchanging data at once. Between racks, that network is optical, and each of its four layers, from lasers to switches, runs a fixed or after-the-fact policy. Lasers sharing an enclosure, cooling, and power can fail together. items.title_cn: Halley：面向光互连AI数据中心网络的预测控制平面
items.note: 用预测控制应对光网络相关故障，提升大规模训练集群可用性。

items.title_en: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
items.summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T via Pass@(K,T), we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. items.title_cn: 多轮强化学习究竟改善了LLM智能体的什么
items.note: 发现多轮RL收益集中在纠错与长程恢复，而非单步决策质量。

items.title_en: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
items.summary: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for cont
items.title_cn: GameVerse：面向长周期交互世界建模的分钟级游戏数据集
items.note: 建分钟级游戏视频数据集，缓解长周期世界模型训练数据稀缺。

huggingface.models_summary: 这几个热门模型集中在文生图、图生视频和图文理解三类，说明多模态生成仍是当前热点；同时出现多个同名或同源模型的再发布版本，反映社区会围绕热门模型做二次分发和封装。对想跟进 AI 圈和备考 AI 方向的人来说，值得注意模型命名里的规模、版本和来源信息，并养成先看项目页确认能力再判断的习惯。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在几条主线：世界模型与视频生成（驾驶、游戏、物理一致性）、智能体与工具使用（记忆、稀疏阅读、多轮强化学习、长周期基建优化）、机器人视觉-语言-动作与触觉、LLM推理路由与量化蒸馏，以及评测基准建设。新手可记住关键词：世界模型、智能体、VLA、多教师蒸馏、基准压缩、长周期评测。
